# create a column purchase frequency days
frequency_mapping = {
    'Fortnightly' : 14,
    'Weekly' : 7,
    'Monthly' : 30,
    'Quaterly' : 90,
    'Bi-Weekly' : 14,
    'Annually' : 365,
    'Every 3 Months' : 90
}

#1. Customer profile

# 1.1  Customer profile
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.histplot(data=df, x='age', bins=20, kde=True, color='Brown', edgecolor='Blue')
plt.title('Age Distrubution')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()
In [139]:
# 1.2 Gender distribution

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
colors = ['skyblue', 'lightcoral']
df['gender'].value_counts().plot(kind='bar', color = colors)
plt.title('Gender Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.show()
In [109]:
# 3. Age group vs purchase amount (boxplot)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
colors = ['red', 'brown', 'purple', 'green']
sns.boxplot(data = df, x='age_group', y='purchase_amount', order = ['Young Adult','Adult','Mid-aged','Senior'], color = colors)
plt.title('Purchase Amount by Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Purchase Amount')
plt.show()
In [129]:
#2 Product and category behavior

#2.1 Top categories by count

plt.figure(figsize=(10,7))
colors = plt.cm.tab20(range(len('category')))

df['category'].value_counts().head(10).plot(kind='pie', color = colors )
plt.title ('Top 10 Categories by Number of Purchases')
plt.xlabel ('category')
plt.ylabel ('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation = 45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
In [155]:
# 2.2 Top categories by revenue

plt.figure(figsize = (10,5))
#colors = plt.cm.tab20(range(len('category')))
(df.groupby('category')['purchase_amount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).plot(kind='bar'))
plt.title('Top 10 Categories by Revenue')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Total Purchase Amount')
plt.xticks(rotation = 50)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
In [177]:
# 2.3 Category by gender (stacked bar)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))
colors = plt.cm.tab10(range(len('Category')))
cat_gender = pd.crosstab(df['category'],df['gender'])
cat_gender_top = cat_gender.loc[cat_gender.sum(axis=1).sort_values(ascending = False).head().index]
cat_gender_top.plot(kind='bar', stacked = True, color = colors)
plt.title('Top 10 Categories by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 5. Correlation heatmap for numeric columns

            'purchase_frequency_days','review_rating']

# Calculate correlation

# Create heatmap

sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', fmt='.2f')
plt.title('Correlation Heatmap')
plt.show()

# 6. Pairplot for a subset
# Take a sample of 1000 rows if data is large
if len(df) > 1000:
    sample_df = df[num_cols + ['gender']].dropna().sample(n=1000, random_state=42)
else:
    sample_df = df[num_cols + ['gender']].dropna()

# Create pairplot
sns.pairplot(sample_df, hue='gender', corner=True)
plt.suptitle('Pairplot of Key Numeric Features by Gender', y=1.02)
plt.show()

from sqlalchemy import create_engine

# MySQL connection
username = "root"
password = "1234"
host = "localhost"
port = "3306"
database = "customer_behaviour"

engine = create_engine(f"mysql+pymysql://{username}:{password}@{host}:{port}/{database}")

# Write DataFrame to MySQL
table_name = "customer"   # choose any table name
df.to_sql(table_name, engine, if_exists="replace", index=False)

# Read back sample
pd.read_sql("SELECT * FROM customer LIMIT 5;", engine)
